equipment_type: Modular water-cooled heat pump chiller controller
applies_to: ClimaCool SHC onDemand water-cooled modular simultaneous heating/cooling heat pumps (UCH, SHC-HP) with the CoolLogic master controller.
summary: ClimaCool's CoolLogic master controller runs the whole bank of up to seven modules and exposes one BACnet device; this list comes from the local access display table, which pairs each screen value with its BACnet object name and point location (AV/BV/MSV and instance). Points cover unit mode, cool/heat run commands, BAS enables, chilled, condenser and source water temperatures, setpoints and resets, and per-module compressor data, alarms and resets.
notes: Table is for software UCH.SHC-HP.12b.13; other software versions may number points differently.
About 90 display values (e.g. calibration offsets, bin-load counters, runtime adjust) have no BACnet point location and are not included.
Per-module points (prefix m1_ to m7_) only apply to fitted modules.
Units are taken from the sample default values; many analog values show no unit in the table.

integration.summary: Set the master controller DIP switches for the BMS port (MS/TP m protocol and baud), keep the device number at 516800, then set Control Source to BAS. Enable cooling and heating through the BAS enable points, write the leaving-water targets, and monitor unit mode, run commands and supply/return temperatures. Keep polling light: the IOM limits it to 50 points at 20-second intervals or slower.

minimum_points.name: control_source_1
minimum_points.why: Control source: Dig Input, Keypad or BAS

integration.enable: Set the master panel LOCAL-OFF-REMOTE switch to Remote and turn Cool/Heat Mode BAS on; the bank then runs on the BAS command. Alternatives are a hard-wired remote enable relay (Digital Input mode) or keypad enable.
integration.remote_sensors: Remote cooling/heating targets can come in as analog inputs (input channel types 'Remote Cool Trg' / 'Remote Heat Trg', 4-20 mA or 2-10 VDC); the resulting values show in rem_chw_stp_stat_1 (AV 243) and rem_cw_stp_stat_1 (AV 246).
setup: Default master board device number is 516800; ClimaCool says other numbers need custom programming.
Port 1 is BACnet over ARC156 (Port 1 Mode jumper to ARC156); the BMS uses Port 2 with DIP 'BMS Port' ON and 'Enhanced Port 2a' OFF.
DIP switches 4-5 set the BMS baud rate and 6-8 the protocol; use 'MS/TP m' for BACnet MS/TP.
For BACnet IP set the IP-address DIP switch ON and configure the address in BACview under FN0 > IP; newer CoolLogic Touch panels use the Gig-E port for BACnet/IP.
gotchas: Poll no more than 50 points, no faster than every 20 seconds.
When re-powering, the CoolLogic master must be the last device powered after the modules to restore communication.
Many writable points are configuration values (limits, delays, PID settings); limit BMS writes to enables and setpoints.

note: Re-typed from the manufacturer's public documentation (see source). Point availability varies by firmware and options; verify against the live device.
